segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company that will seek a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition or similar business combination with one or more businesses.
segments.evidence: We are a blank check company incorporated as an exempted company under the laws of the Cayman Islands on June 9, 2025, which will seek to effect a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities.
